name: models3d_retexture
description: Re-texture a 3D model from a style prompt and/or a reference image. Source: any completed 3D creation (`models3d_generate`, an upload, a rig, or stock).

enableOriginalUv.description: Meshy only: paint onto the model's own UVs instead of re-unwrapping. Default false.

enablePbr.description: Also produce metallic/roughness/normal maps. Default false.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

partNames.description: Tripo only: segmented GLB node names (tripo_part_0, etc) to texture. Omit for the whole model; max 64.

prompt.description: Style described in words. Ignored when referenceImageIdentifier is set.

referenceImageIdentifier.description: Image creation whose look is transferred. Required unless prompt is set.

removeLighting.description: Meshy meshy-6 only: flatten baked lighting out of the texture. Default true.

targetFormats.description: Meshy only. Default ["glb"]. The first is the result `url`, the rest `creations_get` `otherFormats`.
